project: 巴御前 -TOMOE- 30秒 企画デモ
style_lock: anime cinematic, Japanese dark fantasy, crimson and deep indigo palette with gold highlights, fair-skinned female samurai with very long black hair, white hachimaki headband with small silver plate, white-silver and vermilion o-yoroi armor, night cherry blossoms and rising embers, burning Heian-era battlefield, consistent character across shots, no text, no watermark

shots.camera: slow crane down + push-in from high wide angle toward the lone warrior on the hilltop
shots.prompt: Extreme wide establishing shot from behind. A lone female samurai stands on a hilltop, long black hair and white headband ribbons streaming in the wind, naginata in hand, overlooking a vast burning battlefield at night. Embers rise, night cherry blossom petals swirl. Camera slowly cranes down and pushes in toward her silhouette. Epic, quiet, ominous.
shots.negative: text, logo, extra characters in foreground, modern objects, jitter

shots.camera: rack focus from foreground petals to her eyes, very slow dolly-in
shots.prompt: Close-up of the fair-skinned female samurai's face, calm yet piercing gaze into the lens, strands of long black hair moving softly in the hot wind, cherry blossom petals drifting past the lens, warm firelight rim on one side and cool moonlight on the other. She blinks slowly, a subtle breath. Rack focus from petals to her eyes, slow dolly-in.

shots.camera: low-angle fast 90-degree orbit following the swing, ends on a hard stop
shots.prompt: Dynamic anime action: the female samurai sweeps her long naginata in a powerful horizontal slash, a bright crescent arc of light trails the blade, sparks and embers explode outward, long black hair whips around, fierce expression. Low-angle camera orbits fast around her following the swing.
shots.negative: slow motion, blurry face, extra limbs, text

shots.camera: side tracking shot, then snap zoom on the arrow release
shots.prompt: Side view: the female samurai draws a giant Japanese yumi longbow to full draw, holds for a beat with focused eyes, then releases; the arrow shoots out of frame leaving a glowing streak, the bowstring vibrates, embers scatter from the shockwave. Snap zoom-in at the moment of release.
shots.negative: bow bending wrong, multiple arrows, text

shots.prompt: Medium shot: the female samurai calmly and decisively slides her tachi sword back into its black lacquered scabbard, eyes half-closed with quiet resolve and a hint of sorrow, a small metallic glint at the moment the guard meets the scabbard, cherry blossom petals falling slowly under the full moon, battlefield fires dying down behind her. Slow pull-out.

edit_notes: 生成後 public/clips/<id>.mp4 に保存し、src/clips.ts の enabled を true に。尺は Remotion 側でトリム（各シーン尺: shot1 4.0s / shot2 4.3s / shot3 2.3s / shot4 2.3s / shot5 2.3s）。
